name: movie-reservation-system
description: Cinema booking site: live seat map with timed holds, Stripe Checkout (test mode), signed QR tickets by e-mail, a camera door check for staff and an admin panel for films, showtimes and sales. React, Express, PostgreSQL.

paragraphs: A cinema booking site for a small two-hall cinema that shows silent-era classics. Visitors pick seats on a live seat map, pay with Stripe (test mode), and get one QR ticket per seat by e-mail. Staff scan the tickets at the door with a phone camera, and the admin manages films, showtimes and sales.
features: Programme: two halls, three shows a day, for the next two weeks. A daily job adds the coming days by itself, so the programme never runs out.
Typographic posters: every film gets its own poster built from two colours and its title, with no image files.
Drawn from the hall's data, with aisles and wheelchair spaces.
It refreshes every few seconds, so a seat someone else takes shows up on its own.
Every seat is a real button, usable with a keyboard and a screen reader.

requirements.text: Accounts: sign-up with e-mail confirmation, log in, log out and password reset.
Account privacy: sign-up and "forgot password" give the same answer whether or not an e-mail is registered, so nobody can find out which addresses have accounts.
A booking becomes paid only when a signed webhook arrives.
